syllabus.examFormat: Course track · CS4335 · CLRS / KT / AGT
syllabus.compulsoryReading: CLRS (2009); Kleinberg & Tardos (2005); Nisan et al. AGT (2007)

notes: Aligned to CS4335 themes with CLRS, Kleinberg–Tardos, and AGT readings.
Chapter tests ≥70% to unlock next chapter.
Practice levels use questionTarget; assignedQuestionIds empty until ADA drill bank is authored.
Units span design paradigms through mechanism design case studies.

units.title: Overview of algorithm design
units.description: Greedy, divide-and-conquer, and dynamic programming — when and how.

units.title: Algorithm analysis toolkit
units.description: Approximation, online, randomized, streaming, amortized, smoothed; correctness & math tools.

units.title: Graph algorithms
units.description: Representation, search, topo, MST, shortest paths, transitive closure ↔ MM, backtracking.

units.title: String algorithms
units.description: String matching, LCS, and related DP.

units.title: NP-completeness
units.description: Reductions, P vs NP, classic NPC problems, approximation algorithms.

units.title: Game theory overview
units.description: Nash equilibrium, Price of Anarchy & Stability, Prisoner’s Dilemma.

units.title: Games catalog
units.description: Zero-sum, extensive, repeated, stochastic, coalitional, Bayesian, hedonic.

units.title: Mechanism design
units.description: Auctions, matching, facility location, scheduling mechanisms.

units.title: Wrap-up & mocks
units.description: Mixed review, full mocks, weakness clinic.
